GRANT AGREEMENT

Grant Number: HPCF-2026-1188
Grantee: Vistas Youth Arts Collaborative
Grantee Address: 62 Kilburn Street, Harbor Point, Rhode Island 02842
Program: Teen Studio Residency and Neighborhood Mural Program
Grant Amount: One Hundred Eighty-Five Thousand and 00/100 Dollars ($185,000.00 USD)
Project Period: July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027
Date of Agreement: June 4, 2026

ARTICLE 1. GRANT AND PURPOSE

1.1 The Harbor Point Community Foundation (the "Foundation") awards to Vistas Youth Arts Collaborative (the "Grantee") the sum of $185,000.00 to support the Teen Studio Residency and Neighborhood Mural Program (the "Project") during the Project Period.

1.2 The Grantee shall use the grant solely for the Project as described in the Grantee's proposal dated March 20, 2026 and the approved budget attached as Exhibit A.

1.3 The Project Period begins July 1, 2026 and ends June 30, 2027. References in this Agreement to "the end of the Project Period" mean June 30, 2027.

ARTICLE 2. PAYMENT SCHEDULE

2.1 The grant will be paid in two installments:

     $110,000 on or about July 15, 2026
     $ 75,000 on or about January 15, 2027, contingent on acceptance of the Interim Report

2.2 The Foundation may withhold the second installment if the Interim Report is not received or if the Foundation determines that Project activities have materially departed from the approved proposal.

ARTICLE 3. PROJECT DELIVERABLES

3.1 The Grantee shall enroll not fewer than 96 teen participants across three residency cohorts.

3.2 The Grantee shall complete not fewer than six (6) neighborhood murals at sites approved in writing by the Foundation, with the final mural completed and dedicated no later than May 29, 2027.

3.3 The Grantee shall host one public exhibition of participant work during the spring of 2027 and shall provide the Foundation with ten (10) invitations not less than three weeks before the event.

Harbor Point Community Foundation — Grant Agreement HPCF-2026-1188 — Page 2 of 6
[[PAGE]]
Harbor Point Community Foundation — Grant Agreement HPCF-2026-1188 — Page 3 of 6

ARTICLE 4. INTERIM REPORTING

4.1 The Grantee shall submit an interim report covering the first six months of the Project Period no later than January 31, 2027. The interim report shall describe enrollment, mural sites secured, expenditures to date against the approved budget, and any anticipated changes to the Project.

4.2 The interim report shall be submitted through the Foundation's grantee portal in a single PDF file.

ARTICLE 5. FINAL REPORTING

5.1 The Grantee shall submit one final report addressing both programmatic results and the use of grant funds. The final report shall include cumulative participation figures, photographic documentation of each completed mural, a narrative evaluation of outcomes, and a final statement of expenditures compared to the approved budget.

5.2 The final report shall be submitted to the Foundation no later than sixty (60) days after the end of the Project Period.

5.3 The Grantee shall submit with the final report a final financial statement certified by its treasurer. The final financial statement is due within ninety (90) days after the end of the Project Period.

5.4 The Foundation will not consider a renewal request from the Grantee until the final report has been received and accepted.

ARTICLE 6. RECORDS AND ACCESS

6.1 The Grantee shall retain all books, records, and supporting documentation relating to the grant for four (4) years after the end of the Project Period.

6.2 The Foundation may examine the Grantee's records relating to this grant upon fifteen (15) days written notice.

ARTICLE 7. ACKNOWLEDGMENT

7.1 The Grantee shall credit the Harbor Point Community Foundation on each completed mural plaque, in the exhibition program, and on the Grantee's website.

7.2 The Grantee shall obtain signed photo and media releases from the parent or guardian of every participant under eighteen (18) years of age before any image of that participant is published.

Harbor Point Community Foundation — Grant Agreement HPCF-2026-1188 — Page 4 of 6

ARTICLE 8. GENERAL CONDITIONS

8.1 The Grantee shall notify the Foundation in writing within fifteen (15) days of any change in the Grantee's executive director, board chair, or tax-exempt status.

8.2 The Grantee shall obtain the Foundation's written approval before reallocating more than fifteen percent (15%) of any line item in the approved budget.

8.3 Grant funds may not be used for capital improvements to property not owned or leased by the Grantee, for endowment, or for lobbying activities.

8.4 Any grant funds not expended by the end of the Project Period shall be returned to the Foundation unless the Foundation approves a written request to extend the Project Period.

ARTICLE 9. ADMINISTRATIVE SCHEDULE

9.1 This Article restates administrative dates for the convenience of the Grantee's staff.

9.2 The Interim Report is due January 31, 2027.

9.3 The final mural dedication shall occur no later than May 29, 2027.

9.4 The Final Report shall be delivered to the Foundation on or before October 15, 2027.

9.5 The final financial statement shall be delivered to the Foundation on or before December 1, 2027.

9.6 Any request to extend the Project Period must be received before June 1, 2027.

Harbor Point Community Foundation — Grant Agreement HPCF-2026-1188 — Page 4 of 6
[[PAGE]]
Harbor Point Community Foundation — Grant Agreement HPCF-2026-1188 — Page 5 of 6

ARTICLE 10. TERMINATION AND REPAYMENT

10.1 The Foundation may terminate this Agreement upon thirty (30) days written notice if the Grantee fails to perform the deliverables in Article 3, fails to submit required reports, or uses grant funds for purposes other than the Project.

10.2 Upon termination, the Grantee shall return all unexpended grant funds within forty-five (45) days.

ARTICLE 11. SIGNATURES

EXHIBIT A — APPROVED BUDGET AND REPORTING CALENDAR

APPROVED BUDGET

     Teaching artists and residency stipends                   $ 78,000
     Program staff salaries and benefits                       $ 54,500
     Mural materials and equipment rental                      $ 26,300
     Participant transportation and meals                      $  9,700
     Exhibition and documentation                              $  7,500
     Administrative overhead (5.4%)                            $  9,000
     TOTAL                                                     $185,000

REPORTING CALENDAR

     Interim Report due January 31, 2027
     Final Report due September 30, 2027
     Final financial statement due September 30, 2027
     Extension request deadline June 1, 2027

Note to Grantee: the reporting calendar above is provided for planning purposes. Grantees with questions about report due dates should contact their program officer at reports@harborpointcf.org.
